title: Scaffold the app-first Archivist workspace shell
goal: Create the first runnable Archivist app shape: a Vite browser app, a local service boundary, and a workspace abstraction that can host EPP as the first seed without trapping the product inside EPP.
acceptance_criteria: The repo has a Vite app shell that opens to a useful document-workbench surface rather than a marketing page
The app can describe at least one local workspace without hardcoding the original EPP repo as the only possible corpus
The local service boundary is named and documented even if the first slice uses fixtures
The EPP source repo is treated as import evidence or a seed workspace, not as the permanent app layout
The first slice preserves local-only and human-reviewed write assumptions
The first slice names Git-backed history plus an Archivist audit ledger as the history model
The first slice names how the latest document version and historical change lookup will be represented
The repo has a bundled EPP seed workspace with a manifest and representative Markdown bundles
non_goals: Migrating the full EPP corpus in the first commit
Adding cloud sync, external tracker sync, or unattended model writes
Replacing the original EPP process repo
validation: Run the Vite build once the scaffold exists
Smoke the app locally in a browser after the first UI slice exists
notes: This is the first build item after resolving that Archivist should be general and app-first, with EPP as the first serious workspace/proving corpus. Markdown bundles are canonical for v1; history uses real Git for durable file versions plus an Archivist audit ledger for policy-workflow context. The first scaffold uses a small bundled EPP seed workspace and leaves full external workspace opening for the next service-backed slice.
